title: Immortal Life complete family map and production/settlement distinctions
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial source depth, format correction and distinct producer/consumer contracts
reviews.disposition:
F1: Complete map review covers every field of all 296 TextAssets and 203 service rows, 22 family blocks, 15 deep accounts, O-GAP1 and all three negative boundaries. The [lossless reading view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/immortal-life-family-lossless-view-b597.json) uses explicit tuple columns and verified exact ID/source templates; its [round-trip receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/immortal-life-family-view-receipt-b597.json) reconstructs the original 16138-line JSON exactly. Every tuple and common value was actually read. Original map bytes/schema stay unchanged. This does not credit raw tables, declaration bodies, native functions or private captures as newly read.

F2: Statuses are 374 inventory-only, 65 prior-partial, 36 partial-static-deep, 19 partial-static-native and five format-review. These sum to 499 overlapping evidence units, not independent mechanics or complete installed-source coverage. Method counts are declaration census signals; 19 service records contain 73 selected address locators, not full bodies or runtime execution. The report's 100 returned native entry artifacts are a different evidence unit and scope, not a reason to invent 27 missing services or 100 closed flows. Deep CanSaveData/CanStateData/HiveSaveData/Seed/PlantLand routes also differ from the top-level service census. A deep-system or family pointer does not close its host service, all callers, UI, persistence or settlement.

F3: Preserve exact source identifiers and resource path IDs, including whitespace, spelling variants and zero-row resource tables. guxyecheng and guxuecheng variants are not safe to deduplicate or silently merge; zero-row alternate records do not prove the populated area's absence. Named region/portal/teleport rows are not a cross-world carrier contract. Five format-review entries retain the old parse-gap provenance while this report's later C3 refines it: SensitiveWords, crane animation notes and the two line-break sets are expected plain text; Decorate has one readable JSON value plus 399 undecoded characters. Neither repair nor suffix decoding is established. This qualifies B596's earlier non-JSON-or-parse-failure grouping without erasing it.

F4: S01–S22 are inferred candidate homes, not verified YAIRPG consumers. Some UI/runtime helpers route broadly to generic authoring/tools, while others route to their functional family; that label is not a claim of developer-only behavior or an absence of player UI. D01 crop care/maturity, D02 elemental totals/layout, D03 silk stages, D04 hive neighborhood history, D05 station work/collection and D06 fabrication/cancel/refund are distinct state questions. Selected tables and controller addresses do not close seasonal quality, full-bag refusal, all resource return or layout recovery. Pet growth and silk transitions do not prove heredity, human lifespan, children or next-life behavior.

F5: D07 delegation preserves days at admission versus hours in saved remainder, selected future reward index versus harvested custody, and unresolved cancellation disposal/NPC availability/crash atomicity. D08 blessing current-level lookup and process-specific strict threshold are not global luck stacking or complete expiry rules. The reported buff decrement, -1 sentinel and finish predicate do not resolve initial-day/removal ordering or the two-versus-three-day injury description. D09 companion commerce needs actual actor agreement, owned stock and return terms. D10 building/room construction does not close placement/recovery/load. D11 fixed Buy's item/event mutation is not proof of caller payment or a player exploit; rotating pools/refresh need separate source. D12 seasonal basket and D13 barter unlocks distinguish demand/price/custody, learned permission, actual tools and stock.

F6: D14 fishing selection/records does not close every QTE/reward/control consumer. D15 validity/interval/condition/dispatch/count/time/finite removal is a scheduler trace, not successful exactly-once asynchronous consequences or every reachable event. Dialogue, letters/timelines, all saves/versions, study/talent, combat, resource/travel, banquets, alchemy modifiers, smelter debit/refill, Cocoonery health/evolution, storage, salaries/routes, festivals and native presentation remain shallow within the reported bounds. No funded autonomous NPC cultivation is established. O-GAP1 is a dedicated neighborhood/layout-to-production settlement leaf not located in the checked palettes; broad production ML7/MR6 and K9/K25 homes already exist. Retain RP1–RP8 as optional ideas through existing owners rather than a second engine or mandatory framework. Current scope retires the old first-milestone gate; no new acquisition, launch, private-state access, source/runtime/build/browser test, migration, deletion, relocation, commit or push occurs.
reviews.evidence: Complete header/families/deep/gaps read plus all 499 inventory tuples in six bounded outputs; exact reconstruction verified. Full finite REPORT read for actual corrections and source limits.
reviews.reopen: Use selected actual source callers and current YAIRPG evidence for adoption/behavior; keep every shallow family and precise settlement gap.
